repair.finding: A request could leave the process after RESERVED but before SUBMITTED was durably recorded, allowing recovery to replay an ambiguous generation.
changes: add durable SUBMISSION_INTENT before external send
bind exact request digest and provider idempotency semantics before send
recover ambiguous submission intent as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than RESERVED
make pre-call revalidation atomic with invocation reservation unless an exact lease covers the handoff
define ATOMIC_START_SNAPSHOT versus LEASE_THROUGH_SUBMISSION currentness semantics
